verdict.rationale: Typesense has no explicit AI-training policy or opt-out in evidence. It does offer an indirect route: the full engine can be self-hosted free under GPL-3.0, locally or on any server, so your indexed data never has to reach the vendor (typesense-docs-39, typesense-docs-56, typesense-docs-46). LLM integrations for Natural Language Search and RAG use 'LLMs of your choice' (typesense-docs-42), so you also choose which model provider receives your data. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Typesense Cloud customer data is not used for AI training, a documented opt-out or contractual data-use terms, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
